facts.fact: The Agence de Développement du Digital's data-inventory guide (v1.3, published February 2023, no event date given) refers to a national open data portal on which public bodies publish datasets, with a COPIL Open Data and the ADD setting the common framework; it names no open data policy behind the portal, does not say who runs it, and gives no dataset or publisher count.

systems.country_label: Ouverture des données publiques au Maroc
systems.owner: Government of Morocco; ADD with the COPIL Open Data sets the inventory framework
systems.tiers: national; public bodies with a Responsable Open Data (ROD)

note: No standing fact: a methodology manual for public bodies' data inventories, built with World Bank support, with no policy, strategy or law being drafted or adopted.
